sentences.text:
Mr Kl Pandya, App for the Applicant(s) No. 1
 Mr Vijay H Nangesh, Advocate for the Respondent(s) No. 1 - 2
 =

Coram: Honourable Mr.Justice G.R.Udhwani
 Date : 27/11/2015
 Oral Order

1. Considering the fact that accused no.2 was not served with the notice under Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (for short "the Act") as also considering Section 19(2) of the Act, whereunder accused no.2 was entitled to warranty given by accused no.1, the impugned judgment and order dated 08.04.2015 passed in Criminal Case No.1533/2010 by the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ankleshwar, whereby accused no.2 was acquitted, is required to be confirmed.
Accordingly, the leave qua accused no.2 is refused.
2. Insofar as accused no.1 is concerned, in the impugned judgment and order, no infirmity in the evidence tendered before the Court-below is pointed out by the learned Trial Court.

The leave is,
therefore, granted qua accused no.1.
3.
Accordingly, the leave to appeal is disposed of.
List the appeal for admission in due course.
